findings.description: The site footer text is left entirely in English on the French version of the site instead of being translated.
The validation error for the "Nom complet" field is shown in English while all other required-field errors on the same form are correctly translated to French.

findings.observed: Merci. Votre demande pour {montant} a été reçue.
findings.expected: Merci. Votre demande pour 15 000,00 $ a été reçue.
findings.description: The French confirmation message shows the raw template token {montant} instead of the formatted loan amount, unlike the English version which correctly interpolates the value.

The checkbox label is translated with the opposite meaning: "Pay later" becomes "Payer maintenant" (Pay now), contradicting the help text below it which explains the first payment is deferred by 30 days.

The estimated monthly payment is shown using English currency formatting ($450.91) instead of Canadian French formatting (450,91 $), even though the application submission summary page correctly uses fr-CA formatting (15 000,00 $).

findings.expected: Taux variable de 5,2 %, sous réserve d'approbation de crédit.
findings.description: The French rate note omits the qualifier "subject to credit approval" present in the English version, dropping important conditional information.

findings.observed: Aucune accusation pour un remboursement anticipé.
findings.expected: Aucuns frais ne s'appliquent pour un remboursement anticipé.
findings.description: "Accusation" is a mistranslation of "charge" in this financial context; it means a legal accusation in French, not a fee. The correct term is "frais".

findings.expected: Use the same promo image content as English (Taux variable : 5,2 %) so the image, alt text and page copy all agree.
findings.description: The French page displays a different promotional banner image than the English page: it shows "Taux fixe : 4,9 %" (fixed rate 4.9%) while English shows "Variable rate: 5.2%". This contradicts the surrounding page text ("Taux variable de 5,2 %") and the image's own alt text, which incorrectly claims the image says "Taux variable : 5,2 %".
The modal's close link is translated as "Proche" (an adjective meaning "near/close by") instead of the verb "Fermer" (to close), a false-friend mistranslation of the English "Close" button.
The "Recent transactions" section heading on the dashboard is left untranslated on the French page.

Transaction dates on the French dashboard are formatted as US-style MM/DD/YYYY (e.g. 09/15/2026) instead of the ISO/fr-CA style used on the English page (2026-09-15), producing an ambiguous and non-Canadian date format.

findings.expected: Link should point to /fr/calculator on the French dashboard.
findings.description: On the French dashboard, the "Estimer un nouveau prêt" link points to the English calculator page (/en/calculator) instead of the French one, switching the user's language unexpectedly.

"Déclaration mensuelle" is the wrong banking term for "Monthly statement"; in Canadian French banking terminology a bank statement is called "relevé mensuel", not "déclaration" (which implies a tax/legal declaration).
"Balance" is an anglicism in Canadian French banking; the standard term for account balance is "solde".

The landing page hero subtitle uses informal "tu" (Découvre tes) while the rest of the site (e.g. the apply form's consent error "Vous devez donner votre accord...") consistently uses formal "vous", creating an inconsistent register across the application.
